description: React component for handling unread status updates, including updating document title, favicon, and desktop app notifications in Mattermost.

classes.name: UnreadsStatusHandlerClass
classes.description: React component that manages unread status indicators, including updating the page title, favicon, and desktop notifications based on unread messages.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that updates title, favicon, and desktop app notifications when component receives new props.

methods.name: getBadgeStatus
methods.description: Determines badge status (Mention, Unread, None) based on unreadStatus.

methods.name: updateDesktopApp
methods.description: Updates desktop application with current unread and mention counts.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the document title based on current channel, team, and unread status.

methods.name: updateFavicon
methods.description: Updates the favicon based on badge status (mention or unread).
